messages:
emma: opened a lightweight PR to harmonize SDK streaming examples across py/ts/go. intent: show safe close, kv cache hint, resume_token usage, and a short sentence about batch-size tradeoffs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 :memo:

ralph: nice. are we standardizing on 'kv_cache_hint' vs 'KVCacheHint'? pick one casing in all snippets.

maya: vote for snake_case in python snippet and camelCase in TS/Go to match idioms. i'll add a note.

emma: done. python example uses kwargs and shows resume comment.

emma: ```python
# python: streaming, minimal example
with client.stream("gpt-4o-mini", batch_size=4, kv_cache_hint="user:42") as s:
    s.send("summarize: ...")
    for chunk in s:
        handle(chunk)
    # on transient error, call s.resume(resume_token) with same kv_cache_hint
```

ralph: add a tiny try/finally or context manager note for TS to avoid leaked connections.

maya: added this TS snippet:

```ts
// typescript: ensure close to free sockets
const s = await client.stream('gpt-4o-mini', { batchSize: 4, kvCacheHint: 'user:42' })
try {
  await s.send('summarize: ...')
  for await (const chunk of s) {
    onChunk(chunk)
  }
} finally {
  await s.close()
}
```

emma: added a one-liner under "Retries & resumption": "When resuming, pass the last resume_token and the same kv_cache_hint to avoid duplicated context."

ralph: small wording nit: in "Batching guidance" please explain 4 vs 8 in one line.

emma: added: "Use small batches (4) for interactive low-latency streams; increase to 8-16 for throughput-oriented processing."

maya: LGTM, will do a final wording pass and approve. thanks :rocket:
